evidence: Carries the IPC label and hardens node implementations of interfaces::Chain against IPC caller crashes and validation scheduler thread termination.
rationale: Prevents bitcoin-node crashes and scheduler thread termination caused by invalid IPC arguments or failing client notification handlers. As noted in the description, interfaces::Chain asserted or dereferenced null on invalid inputs, and uncaught IPC client exceptions on the validation scheduler thread terminate the node process, blocking IPC consumers in #29409.
